title: Convergence of kernel and neural-network methods for Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equations on unbounded domains
summary: We derive error bounds from empirical squared residuals for two non-monotone, mesh-free approximations of Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equations on unbounded spatial domains: collocation with Wendland kernels under a native space norm constraint, and physics-informed neural networks with smooth activations under a Sobolev-norm constraint. The main step is to recover the pointwise residual control needed for viscosity-solution error estimates from the empirical loss, while quantifying the discretization or sampling error.
